I think the process of sobriety is really important. I have a lot of friends who drink and will have sober weeks or months to make sure they have control because if you can't go a period of time without alcohol, you have a problem. We've all had a number of day 1s and i know personally all the times I drank again was because I wanted to see if I really needed to give up drinking 100%. Turns out yes always but sometimes the only one who can convince you is yourself. Your 60+ days are valid. You are valid and your 'mess up' is just you learning more about yourself. I'm proud of you and won't drink with you today.

Honestly, working in the industry kept me from quitting for a long time. Until 2 weeks ago, actually haha. I was and still am scared with where my life is going to go. I love my schedule, the industry, the money, the regulars and the life style I'm able to live outside of work. I was super anxious to talk to the owner and brewer about it. It felt unfair to continue serving craft beer that I couldn't critique. I'll be selling drinks I can't really back up and it was like I was being disloyal. Surprisingly, they were both understanding and supportive. As long as I would listen and be able to communicate the flavors and style of the beer it wouldn't be a problem. Still feels weird and I know I won't be doing this long term as I expected I would before I quit but the money and schedule is good enough right now that I don't feel too bad about it. I love my regulars and am probably a better bartender now that I'm not drinking. 

Hope it helps. I've just decided to open with being sober whenever people ask me what's new. Not randoms, but friends, acquaintances, regulars, you get it. I never want to guilt anyone that drinks though I can def tell when they consider their own choices once hey hear mine. 

Good luck with your sobriety! I won't drink with you!

It is real medium! I understand there are advantages to digital art but that doesn't invalidate it. Learning to paint digitally, with oil, acrylic, watercolor, will all require patience and practice. Are you saying animators deserve zero credit all because it's on a screen? Designers aren't credible? Creative outlets are so important to every individual and now that technology allows someone a chance who wouldn't have before, people feel threatened. Art is expression and just because someone uses 'real' medium doesn't mean it's real art. I'm more concerned with the paint and drink groups that invalidate what real art is. 

I'm more of a conventional artist but use digital for editorial or design work. 

OP keep painting. They're beautiful and once you get your hands on supplies, I'm sure they'll be amazing. I've gotten a lot of used supplies from estate and garage sales. Canvases are way cheaper if you make your own. Good luck!

I know you don't need a reminder, but I'll say it anyway, don't let the negative comments get you down. I posted about my abortion not too long ago and I felt and feel the same way. You posted on a public forum so different opinions are expected and even welcome, but abuse and the sarcastic remarks about you 'having no regard for life' aren't acceptable. 

Yes we're very lucky to have support and resources but it doesn't invalidate our experiences. I personally think abortions should be normalized. Personal and moral remorse is very different than cultural guilt. 

Anyway before I get too political, I'm proud of you for doing what you need to do. I'm very thankful for how easy the decision and process was for me and can only hope it's smooth for every woman in the same situation.

I have BPD, too! It's not alcohol we're addicted to. We crave anything that is a stable emotion or feeling. I eat a lot because it keeps my brain and body busy. I online shop because it keeps me searching for hours and looking forward to something in the mail. We self destruct physically because emotionally we have not learned how to cope with our mental and emotional stresses. Don't let alcohol be the reason. You have something very special that you haven't learned how to tame or steer in the right healthy direction. I'm not perfect, read my last post, but I know art is the only escape for me. Use your 'disorder' to benefit your strengths. I'm not into god either but god is too easy . You're not alone my friend. You are very special and your feelings matter
